title: What happened to Franklin Clinton after GTA 5
subject: franklin
description:
Which ending did you pick for Franklin? 👇

Where Franklin Clinton ended up eight years after GTA 5, and what it says about the canon ending. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online: The Contract.

scenes.text: Eight years after his last heist, Franklin Clinton had a business card.
In The Contract, a 2021 GTA Online story, he runs F. Clinton and Partner.
It fixes problems for the rich and famous, people he once repossessed cars from.
Lamar Davis works beside him, still roasting him every chance he gets.
Back in GTA 5, the FIB and Devin Weston had told him to kill Michael or Trevor.
A calm, rich Franklin with his old crew around looks like a man who refused both.
That's why fans believe Deathwish, the ending where all three survive, is the true one.
